response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM per_type) SELECT p.tradekind AS trader_type, p.cnt AS record_count, p.cnt * 1.0 / s.total_cnt AS share_of_total, p.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS diff_from_avg FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE s.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND p.cnt > s.avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Traders with NULL tradekind form one group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together), and it is included in the per-type average and total like any other group.

The average is the plain mean of per-type counts (each group weighted equally), not the mean per record or per trader. Share is the count divided by the sum of all per-type counts, using decimal division with no rounding.
